item.title: Co-inference 0.1.0-preview.16
item.description: Adds a pipeline setting for 3–9 reviewable argument steps and removes unused classifier output requirements while preserving active retrieval inputs. Repairs an unambiguous missing JSON closing delimiter locally without repeating completed research or changing its content. Existing jobs retain their launch settings on resume. Unnotarized preview; Linux packaging verification does not establish macOS launch or restart behavior.
